result.topic_en: Euler applies his theorem on turning series into continued fractions to the series for the integral Z = ∫z^{m-1}dz(1+z^n)^{k/n-1}, obtaining a general continued fraction, and then specialises it to Z = ∫dz/√(1+zz) = l(z+√(1+zz)).

$v=\frac{z^{m-n}}{m}\left(z^n-\frac{m+k}{m+n}z^{2n}+\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)}{(m+n)(m+2n)}z^{3n}-\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)(m+2n+k)}{(m+n)(m+2n)(m+3n)}z^{4n}\text{ etc.}\right)$

§. 56. Cum iam sit
$Z=\int z^{m-1}dz(1+z^n)^{\frac{k}{n}-1}$, statuamus
$V=\frac{mZ}{z^{m-n}(1+z^n)^{\frac{k}{n}}}$, vt fiat
$V=z^n-\frac{m+k}{m+n}z^{2n}+\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)}{(m+n)(m+2n)}z^{3n}-\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)(m+2n+k)}{(m+n)(m+2n)(m+3n)}z^{4n}+\text{etc.}$
erit igitur V functio ipsius z per integrationem formulae differentialis eruenda, quae ergo pro quouis valore ipsius z determinatum adipiscetur valorem, siquidem integrale ita capi ponimus, vt euanescat facto $z=0$. Quo igitur facilius istos valores ipsius v assignare queamus, quando variabili z valores fracti tribuuntur, statuamus in genere $z^n=\frac{x}{y}$, ita vt hanc formam nanciscamur:
$V=\frac{x}{y}-\frac{(m+k)xx}{(m+n)yy}+\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)x^3}{(m+n)(m+2n)y^3}-\frac{(m+k)(m+n+k)(m+2n+k)x^4}{(m+n)(m+2n)(m+3n)y^4}+\text{etc.}$
quae series cum nostro Theoremate collata praebet $s=V$; tum vero
$a=1,\ b=m+k,\ c=m+n+k,$ etc.
$\alpha=1,\ \beta=m+n,\ \gamma=m+2n,$ etc.

§. 57. His notatis formula integralis assumta sequentem nobis suppeditat fractionem continuam:
$\frac{x}{V}=$

$\frac{x}{V}=y+\cfrac{(m+k)xy}{(m+n)y-(m+k)x+\cfrac{(m+n)(m+n+k)xy}{(m+2n)y-(m+n+k)x+\cfrac{(m+2n)(m+2n+k)xy}{(m+3n)y-(m+2n+k)x-\text{etc.}}}}$
cuius valor erit $\frac{xz^{m-n}(1+z^n)^{\frac{k}{n}}}{mZ}$.

§. 58. Exempli gratia sumamus hanc formam:
$Z=\int\frac{dz}{\sqrt{(1+zz)}}=l(z+\sqrt{(1+zz)})$,
erit igitur $m=1,\ n=2,\ k=1$, fietque $V=\frac{z\,l(z+\sqrt{(1+zz)})}{\sqrt{(1+zz)}}$
qui valor aequatur huic seriei:
$zz-\frac{2}{3}z^4+\frac{2\cdot4}{3\cdot5}z^6-\frac{2\cdot4\cdot6}{3\cdot5\cdot7}z^8+\text{etc.}$
quae, si iam loco zz scribamus $\frac{x}{y}$, fiet
$V=\frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{(x+y)}}\,l\left(\frac{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{(x+y)}}{\sqrt{y}}\right)$
$=\frac{x}{y}-\frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{xx}{yy}+\frac{2\cdot4}{3\cdot5}\cdot\frac{x^3}{y^3}-\frac{2\cdot4\cdot6}{3\cdot5\cdot7}\cdot\frac{x^4}{y^4}+\text{etc.}$
quare fractio continua hinc formata erit
$\frac{\sqrt{x(x+y)}}{l\frac{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{(x+y)}}{\sqrt{y}}}=y+\cfrac{1\cdot2xy}{3y-2x+\cfrac{3\cdot4xy}{5y-4x+\cfrac{5\cdot6xy}{7y-6x+\cfrac{7\cdot8xy}{9y-8x+\text{etc.}}}}}$

§. 59. Quodsi ergo sumamus $x=1$ et $y=1$, habebimus istam fractionem continuam:
